basic_details.job_title: APTRANSCO Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Range Officer / Assistant Range Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Transmission Corporation of A.P. Limited (APTRANSCO), Vidyut Soudha, Vijayawada, is engaging 2 retired Range Officers / Assistant Range Officers on contract basis at Rs.75,000 per month including all allowances, for one year (maximum three years). Only retired Government employees from the Forest Department cadre who retired not more than five years before 27 November 2026 can apply, on the prescribed format by post or email, on or before 17 December 2026 at 05:30 PM.

how_to_apply: Interested candidates should apply in the prescribed format attached to the notification (Annexure-I), in duplicate, along with relevant copies of enclosures as per the check list. The envelope or application must superscribe the post applied for. It is addressed to:
The Chairman & Managing Director, 4th Floor, SLDC Building, APTRANSCO, Vidyut Soudha, Vijayawada, Pin code: 520004.
The notice also allows applying through email at [email protected]. The last date for receipt of application is 17 December 2026 at 05:30 PM. The notice does not mention an email subject line.
Application in the prescribed proforma as per Annexure-I, in duplicate.
Self-attested copies of certificates or documents supporting date of birth, educational qualifications, nationality and caste, wherever applicable.
Copies of retirement orders, service certificate and other documents establishing experience in the cadre of Range Officer / Assistant Range Officer.
Last Pay Drawn Certificate and Pension Payment Order (PPO) as applicable.
A brief statement of relevant experience in forest administration, conservation, land diversion, clearances, compensatory afforestation, boundaries and statutory procedures, wherever applicable.
A signed declaration of willingness to work on contract basis and discharge the responsibilities in the notification and Annexure-II.
Any other relevant documents supporting the qualifications and experience claimed, and the education qualification proof.

The Annexure-I form asks for details of previous employment, personal details (including Aadhar No. and PAN), addresses, educational qualifications, service and experience, positions held during the last 10 years, special experience in forest matters, vigilance or disciplinary proceedings, last pay drawn and pension particulars, and willingness to work on contract for an initial one year at Vijayawada or Kadapa zone. It also asks for a list of existing health problems. Its enclosure list adds a Vigilance/Disciplinary Clearance Certificate, wherever applicable.
important_instructions: APTRANSCO will not entertain information furnished by the candidate subsequently, so applicants should be careful when writing the application. If any lapse is detected during scrutiny, the candidature will be rejected even if the candidate comes through the final stage of the engagement process or at a later date. The candidate should not furnish false, tampered or fabricated information or suppress any material information in the application. APTRANSCO reserves the right to modify or cancel the notification or engaging process without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About APTRANSCO
content_sections.text: According to the notice, APTRANSCO was incorporated under the Indian Companies Act 1956 and is a wholly owned State Government Company. The Company is presently engaged in transmission of power, grid operations, transmission management, projects and technical subjects. This engagement is for forest-related coordination work in connection with its transmission lines, substations and projects.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired Government employee who has served in the cadre of Range Officer or Assistant Range Officer in the Forest Department of the Government of Andhra Pradesh or any other State Government. The applicant must have retired from regular Government service not more than five (5) years prior to the date of the notification, which is 27 November 2026. Preference is given to candidates with adequate knowledge and experience in forest administration, forest conservation, forest laws, diversion of forest land for non-forest purposes, forest clearances, compensatory afforestation, identification and demarcation of forest lands, forest boundaries and related statutory procedures. The applicant must have good administrative, communication, coordination and drafting skills. Telugu language reading and writing skills are a must. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the assigned duties. The notice does not specify a minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility conditions of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs.75,000/- per month, including all allowances, and is subject to applicable statutory deductions, if any. The engagement is for one (1) year, with a maximum of three (3) years. The tenure will be extended every year based on yearly assessment and evaluation of performance by the authorities. The selected candidates will be posted at one of two offices, as decided by APTRANSCO: Head Quarters, Vidyut Soudha, Vijayawada, or Kadapa zone, APTRANSCO, Kadapa. The Corporation reserves the right to allocate or change the place of posting depending upon administrative requirements.

content_sections.heading: APTRANSCO Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected officers shall coordinate with the Chief Engineers, Zonal Offices, Circles and other authorities of APTRANSCO for smooth functioning of GEC and asset coordination, particularly on forest-related issues, until their logical conclusion. They also coordinate with the Forest Department and other Government authorities. Annexure-II lists these duties: Coordinate with Chief Engineers, Superintending Engineers, Divisional Engineers and other APTRANSCO officers to identify, examine and resolve forest-related issues of transmission lines, substations and other infrastructure projects, and submit proposals and documents. Liaise with the Forest Department (Principal Chief Conservator of Forests, Conservators of Forests, Divisional Forest Officers, Forest Range Officers and others) for expeditious processing and clearance of forest proposals, and pursue them with State and Central Government authorities until final approval by the Government of India. Assist in identifying and verifying forest lands within the alignment of transmission lines, proposed substation sites and other project locations. Coordinate preparation and processing of proposals for diversion of forest land for non-forest purposes, wherever required, under the applicable forest laws and Government guidelines. Assist in forest clearances, including Stage-I and Stage-II approvals, compliance with stipulated conditions and submission of documents and reports. Coordinate identification and demarcation of forest boundaries, survey numbers, forest compartments and other land particulars with the Forest Department. Assist in proposals on compensatory afforestation, Net Present Value (NPV), compensatory levies and other statutory requirements. Examine forest maps, compartment maps, working plans, forest records, survey sketches and other documents on forest lands affected by APTRANSCO projects. Coordinate for permissions, recommendations, clearances and statutory approvals needed for transmission projects. Monitor pending forest clearance proposals and ensure timely submission of clarifications and compliance reports by APTRANSCO field officers. Assist in resolving issues on tree enumeration, tree felling permissions, right of way, vegetation clearance and other forest-related requirements for line construction and maintenance. Assist APTRANSCO authorities in addressing objections and representations raised by Forest Department officials and other stakeholders. Undertake field and joint inspections with APTRANSCO and Forest Department officials, wherever required, and submit reports with recommendations. Maintain records of forest-related cases, proposals, permissions, statutory compliance and pending issues, with action taken. Coordinate with APTRANSCO officers to ensure compliance with conditions imposed by the Forest Department and other competent authorities. Prepare periodic progress reports on forest-related issues for the concerned APTRANSCO authorities. Perform other duties on
